import os,sys,subprocess,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
S=Path(r"C:\Users\manem\Desktop\QASCP\public-review-20261125")
O=Path(r"C:\Users\manem\AppData\Local\Temp\qascp-re-audit-20261126-5919d022")
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith("GIT_")}
env.update(GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM="1",GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=os.devnull,PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1")
marker="QASCP-NONSECRET-FINAL-VERIFICATION"
rows=[]
for mode in ("clean","direct","include","conditional","worktree","worktree-disabled"):
 for key in (("none",) if mode=="clean" else ("credential.helper","http.extraheader","core.sshCommand")):
  name="04-probe-"+mode+"-"+key.replace(".","-").lower()
  repo=O/name; repo.mkdir()
  def git(*args,check=True):
   return subprocess.run(["git",*args],cwd=repo,env=env,capture_output=True,check=check)
  git("init","--quiet")
  if mode=="direct":git("config","--local",key,marker)
  if mode in ("include","conditional"):
   included=repo/"probe-included.config"
   git("config","--file",str(included),key,marker)
   directive="include.path" if mode=="include" else "includeIf.gitdir:**/"+name+"/.git.path"
   git("config","--local",directive,str(included))
  if mode.startswith("worktree"):
   git("config","--local","extensions.worktreeConfig","true")
   git("config","--worktree",key,marker)
   if mode=="worktree-disabled":git("config","--local","--unset-all","extensions.worktreeConfig")
  effective=git("config","--show-scope","--name-only","--list").stdout.decode()
  local=git("config","--local","--includes","--name-only","--list").stdout.decode()
  r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-B",str(S/"scripts/verify_checkout_auth.py")],cwd=repo,env=env,capture_output=True)
  row=dict(mode=mode,key=key,effective_key_present=key.lower() in effective.lower(),local_query_key_present=key.lower() in local.lower(),guard_exit=r.returncode,marker_exposed=marker.encode() in r.stdout+r.stderr,guard_output=r.stdout.decode().strip(),diagnostic=r.stderr.decode().strip())
  if mode in ("include","conditional","direct","worktree"):assert row["effective_key_present"],row
  rows.append(row)
(O/"04-independent-checkout-probe.json").write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2),encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))
